controls.explanation: The colour light takes passing through the pane: faintly green, as the iron in soda-lime float glass makes it.
controls.label: Glass tint

controls.explanation: How blurred reflections and the view through clean glass are, in thousandths. Float glass is nearly perfectly smooth.
controls.label: Glass roughness

controls.explanation: The colour of the dust and grime a street leaves on the glass.
controls.label: Film colour

controls.explanation: How rough the glass is where film covers it completely, in thousandths.
controls.label: Film roughness

controls.explanation: The most light the dust in a patch stops passing through, in percent.
controls.label: Dust

controls.explanation: How many patches of settled dust fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Dust patches

controls.explanation: How many dust flecks fit across one tile; more means finer dust.
controls.label: Dust fineness

controls.explanation: The most light the streaks left by running rain stop passing through, in percent.
controls.label: Rain streaks

controls.explanation: How many streaks fit side by side across one tile.
controls.label: Streak spacing

controls.explanation: How many streak lengths fit down one tile; fewer means longer streaks.
controls.label: Streak length

controls.explanation: The most light the faint marks of hands and cleaning stop passing through, in percent.
controls.label: Handling marks

controls.explanation: How many handling marks fit across one tile; more means smaller marks.
controls.label: Mark size
